thread:
billing-bot: Payment failed for invoice INV-9921 (Acme Corporation). PO present (PO-7876). Card fallback attempted and declined. Creating escalation ticket.
Jen (Support): pinging finance — customer says they supply PO and expected no card charge.
Samir (CS): Customer emailed — PO attached, net-30 terms. They were downgraded mid-cycle which should have created a prorated credit, not a charge.
Mario (Billing): Can you paste the invoice and payment attempt logs? need to check if card was actually captured or only attempted.
billing-bot: Payment log snippet:
```
invoice_id: INV-9921
customer: ACME_Corp
payment_methods: [PO-7876, card-ending-4242]
attempts:
  - ts: 2024-11-29T09:12:07Z status: hold method: PO reason: PO-not-approved
  - ts: 2024-11-29T09:12:45Z status: decline method: card-ending-4242 code: card_declined
  - ts: 2024-11-29T09:13:00Z status: ledger: unpaid failure_reason: tax_mismatch
```
Sophie (Finance): Interesting — the ledger shows a small rounding delta from the proration calc after downgrade: delta = EUR 0.12. That explains ledger != invoice balance.
Lina (Accounting): If the card was declined we shouldn't have issued a refund, but the invoice status is weird (partially_paid). Did we apply any provisional credit?
Aisha (Payments): the gateway returned `tax_mismatch` when trying to apply the fallback charge — our flow still marked the attempt and set a provisional applied amount (internal id: PAY-4432) which created the partial_paid state. That provisional didn't capture.
Elliot (Eng): repro steps from payments service logs:
1) customer created downgrade event -> service recalculates prorate -> creates credit memo CM-224
2) billing worker sees outstanding balance and PO present -> calls payments API with `fallback_to_card: true`
3) payment API tried card charge, gateway returned `tax_mismatch` (EU VAT rounding edge for split taxes) -> worker marked attempt and left invoice in partial state
Code snippet of call:
```json
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-9921",
  "amount_due": "124.88",
  "fallback_to_card": true,
  "po_number": "PO-7876",
  "customer_vat": "DE123456789"
}
```
Jen (Support): TL;DR customer has PO, card fallback should not have been used (their contract says PO required). They also saw a small residual charge issue.
Mario (Billing): Proposed remediation:
- Void any provisional applied amounts (PAY-4432) so invoice returns to unpaid but not partial.
- Issue a manual credit note for the proration rounding (EUR 0.12) referencing CM-224 and INV-9921.
- If any card capture succeeded (double-check with gateway) process a refund.
- Update the invoice metadata to mark `po_enforced: true` to prevent future fallback.
Sophie (Finance): Agreed. Also need to post the manual credit to GL code 4500 and include VAT lines matching original invoice (split tax: 19%/0% for EU digital services vs local exemption). Otherwise tax reporting will mismatch.
Lina (Accounting): I can create the credit note once you confirm the exact VAT amounts to attach. Who can calculate the tax split on the adjusted amount (post-proration)?
Elliot (Eng): I can emit a deterministic proration breakdown endpoint for auditing; for now here's the quick calc: original charge pre-downgrade = EUR 250.00 net, downgrade prorated usage = EUR 125.12 net, resulting credit = 124.88 gross. VAT split on the credit matches invoice lines: VAT 19% on applicable portion -> VAT = 19.00, rounding leads to 0.12 residual.
Samir (CS): Customer wants a single document (credit note + explanation) they can send to accounts payable. Also they want PO enforcement so this doesn't recur.
Aisha (Payments): I've flagged PAY-4432 as provisional-only and cleared the applied amount. Gateway shows no settled capture for card-ending-4242. No refund required.
Mario (Billing): Lina — please generate credit note CN-9921-1 for EUR 0.12 and attach to INV-9921. Post to GL 4500, tag `correction: proration-rounding`. Sophie — can you confirm VAT lines to include?
Sophie (Finance): Confirmed VAT line: VAT amount EUR 0.00 on exempt portion, VAT EUR 0.12 on taxed portion to balance the rounding. Add note: "manual rounding correction after mid-cycle downgrade; original credit memo CM-224".
Lina (Accounting): Creating CN-9921-1 now. Will attach to invoice and close ledger discrepancy. Posting in tomorrow's batch.
Jen (Support): I'll reply to the customer with timeline: credit note will be issued and applied within 24h, no card charge happened, PO enforcement will be enabled on their tenant.
Elliot (Eng): I'll push a small change to billing worker to skip `fallback_to_card` when `po_enforced` or `po_present && po_terms == 'net'`. Will drop a PR and notify ops.
Mario (Billing): After credit is posted, run the reconciliation job for date 2024-11-29 so ledger aligns. Ping here when done.
billing-bot: Ticket updated: ESC-7785 - action items assigned (void provisional, create CN-9921-1, update tenant PO settings, deploy billing worker patch).
Samir (CS): Customer confirmed they're happy with that plan. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Lina (Accounting): Done — CN-9921-1 created and attached. Ledger now reconciled, outstanding balance 0.00.
Mario (Billing): Reconciliation job completed at 2024-11-30T03:20:50Z. Closing thread.
